title: The Great Migration Classic
subtitle: Ten Days in the Heart of the Serengeti
overview: The Great Migration Classic is our signature East African expedition — a carefully choreographed 10-day journey through Tanzania's greatest wilderness areas, timed to coincide with the wildebeest migration and designed for guests who want an exceptional safari without compromise.
highlights: Witness a wildebeest river crossing at the Mara River
Track lion prides and cheetah families on the open plains
Dawn balloon flight over the migration with champagne breakfast
Two private conservancy game drives away from park crowds
Visit to a Maasai community partnership village

days.title: Arrival in Arusha
days.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport where our team meets you and transfers you to your hotel in Arusha. An evening briefing covers the journey ahead, followed by a welcome dinner featuring local cuisine.

days.title: Tarangire — Land of Giants
days.description: Fly by light aircraft to Tarangire, famous for its enormous elephant herds and iconic baobab trees. An afternoon game drive reveals the park's extraordinary biodiversity before your first night under canvas.

days.title: Full Day in Tarangire
days.description: A full day in the park, with morning and afternoon game drives and a bush picnic lunch. Tarangire is one of Tanzania's best-kept secrets — less visited than the Serengeti but often exceeding it for sheer animal density in the dry season.

days.title: Into the Serengeti
days.description: Fly to the central Serengeti and check in to your first camp. An afternoon introduction drive across the golden plains sets the scene for the days ahead. Sundowners on a kopje as the sky turns copper and rose.

days.title: Big Cat Focus Day
days.description: Your guide has been tracking three cheetah coalitions and two lion prides. Today we focus on predator behaviour — following up on kills, tracking individual animals, and learning to read the savanna like a naturalist.

days.title: Flight to the Mara River
days.description: Fly north to the migration camps near the Mara River, the scene of the famous crossings. Arrive in time for an afternoon vigil at the river, waiting for the moment when thousands of wildebeest decide to plunge in.

days.title: The Great Crossing
days.description: A full day at the river. Nothing about the crossing can be predicted — the wildebeest may surge once, twice, or not at all. When it happens, it is one of nature's most overwhelming spectacles: dust, roaring, crocodiles surging, and thousands of animals pouring down the bank.

days.title: Balloon Safari & Maasai Village
days.description: Pre-dawn departure for your hot air balloon flight, drifting silently above the plains as the migration moves below. A champagne breakfast in the bush follows. Afternoon visit to a partnership Maasai community.

days.title: Private Conservancy — Game Without Limits
days.description: Transfer to an exclusive private conservancy bordering the Serengeti, where game drives continue after dark and off-road driving is permitted. Evening walking safari with an armed ranger.

days.title: Farewell to Africa
days.description: A final sunrise game drive before flying back to Arusha and connecting to your onward flights. Guests often describe this last morning light on the savanna as the moment that stays with them longest.

inclusions: All game drives with expert guide
